title: Community-driven development
author: MediumSweetPotato
selftext:
I have an idea but no time to implement it. TL:DR: 

making the assumption that ai’s are fully capable coders, the idea is to have a forum-based community decide the direction of games. “Magic“ runs the backend to turn discussions/votes into specs, then anyone who wants to donate their tokens to the game can run ‘npm fossArcade -contribute -gameName’ or whatever to build/fix whatever is next as decided by the community. 

More thoughts:

python has a good system for community-driven dev

copyright is a minefield

people aren’t good at knowing what they want

people are worse at knowing what an entire player base needs

ais are too sloppy to work right now. Refactor every 90 days?

feature specs/unit tests etc. should be approved before going into TODO

have a generic base game and everything else is effectively a mod on top. This way the same game can turn into multiple variations. 

if you have a stack of working/compatible mods, have a quick  method for getting on the same stack. Config encrypt -> short something?

Extend out to commercial software. 

Ai will also have to compare competing PRs

 there’s Reddit and GitHub discussions and probably slack, maybe discorse can do it too. If you know of something like this, let me know, it’s the end of the month and I have some tokens left.
